safety_notes: Street-invitation scam: never follow anyone who approaches the group and invites you to a bar. Standard Budapest consumption-trap routine; bills land in the hundreds with security on the door.

Strip clubs are the biggest rip-off risk in the city. Ask for a printed price list, pay each round rather than running a tab, agree private-dance prices out loud beforehand. NANA and Mynt were selected specifically because entry is free with no minimum spend.
Decline dynamic currency conversion — always pay in HUF, not euros.
